mcqs.question: Which of the following metals reacts most vigorously with cold water to produce hydrogen gas?
mcqs.explanation: Sodium, being high in the reactivity series, reacts rapidly with cold water, liberating hydrogen gas. Magnesium reacts only with hot water, iron does not react with water, and copper is inert towards water.

mcqs.question: Metal X is placed in dilute hydrochloric acid and bubbles of gas are observed. Metal Y shows no visible reaction under the same conditions. Which statement correctly compares the reactivity of the two metals?

options.A: Metal X is less reactive than Metal Y.
options.B: Metal X is more reactive than Metal Y.
options.C: Both metals have the same reactivity.
options.D: Reactivity cannot be inferred from this observation.

mcqs.answer: Metal X is more reactive than Metal Y.
mcqs.explanation: A metal that displaces hydrogen from an acid (producing gas) is higher than hydrogen in the reactivity series, indicating greater reactivity. The metal that shows no reaction is lower in the series.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about hydrogen displacement by metals is correct?

options.A: Only metals that are above hydrogen in the reactivity series can displace hydrogen from acids.
options.B: All metals, irrespective of their position in the reactivity series, can displace hydrogen from acids.
options.C: No metal can displace hydrogen from acids.
options.D: Only non‑metals can displace hydrogen from acids.

mcqs.answer: Only metals that are above hydrogen in the reactivity series can displace hydrogen from acids.
mcqs.explanation: Metals situated above hydrogen in the reactivity series (e.g., Zn, Fe, Mg) can donate electrons to H⁺ ions, releasing H₂ gas. Metals below hydrogen (e.g., Cu, Ag) cannot.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: Metal M is placed in an aqueous solution of aluminium chloride (AlCl₃). Which of the following outcomes is most likely?

options.A: No reaction occurs because aluminium is more reactive than metal M.
options.B: Metal M displaces aluminium from the solution, forming MClₓ and depositing aluminium metal.
options.C: Aluminium displaces metal M, forming Al metal and MClₓ.
options.D: Both metals precipitate as insoluble hydroxides.

mcqs.answer: Metal M displaces aluminium from the solution, forming MClₓ and depositing aluminium metal.
mcqs.explanation: If metal M is higher than aluminium in the reactivity series, it can reduce Al³⁺ ions to aluminium metal while itself getting oxidized to its chloride. The opposite would happen if M were lower.

mcqs.question: Arrange the following metals in order of decreasing vigor of reaction with water: Potassium (K), Calcium (Ca), Magnesium (Mg), Iron (Fe).
mcqs.explanation: Potassium reacts explosively with water, calcium reacts slowly with cold water, magnesium reacts only with hot water, and iron shows negligible reaction. Hence the decreasing order is K > Ca > Mg > Fe.

mcqs.question: Which metal will NOT react with dilute hydrochloric acid at room temperature?
mcqs.explanation: Copper lies below hydrogen in the reactivity series, so it cannot displace hydrogen from dilute HCl. Zinc, iron, and magnesium are above hydrogen and therefore react, producing hydrogen gas.

mcqs.question: When a metal reacts with an acid, which gas is commonly evolved?
mcqs.explanation: Acidic solutions contain H⁺ ions. Metals that are more reactive than hydrogen reduce H⁺ to H₂ gas, which is observed as bubbling.

mcqs.learning_point: Use the reactivity series to predict reactions
mcqs.question: Which metal will displace copper from copper(II) sulfate solution?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it can reduce Cu²⁺ ions to copper metal, depositing copper and forming ZnSO₄. Silver, gold, and platinum are less reactive and cannot displace copper.
